stem: Vikram starts at point O facing North. He walks 4 km, then turns left and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 2 km. In which direction is Vikram from point O now?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Facing North, turn left (West), walk 3 km, turn right (North), walk 2 km: final position is 3 km West and 6 km North of O, which is North-West.
Swapping left for right and right for left at every turn places Vikram 3 km East and 6 km North of O, which is North-East.
Adding all distances as a straight northward journey (4+3+2 = 9 km North) and ignoring the direction changes gives a final position due North.
Reading the starting direction as South instead of North places Vikram 3 km East and 6 km South of O, which is South-East.

explanation: From O, Vikram walks 4 km North to (0,4). He turns left (now facing West) and walks 3 km to (-3,4). He turns right (now facing North again) and walks 2 km to (-3,6). Relative to O, he is 3 km West and 6 km North, placing him in the North-West direction.
